findings.reason: lib/yargs-parser.ts:984 passes negatedBoolean to hasFlagsMatching unconditionally (the diff removed the `configuration['boolean-negation']` guard), and hasFlagsMatching (936-941) treats the arg as known when the captured name is a known flag. The parse loop at line 253 only treats it as a negation when boolean-negation is true, so with negation off the two paths disagree and `--no-foo` falls through to normal flag parsing as `no-foo`. No story.md is in the packet or export, so breaks is left unset.
findings.claim: isUnknownOption now always matches `--no-<known>` through negatedBoolean, even with 'boolean-negation' off. With 'unknown-options-as-args' on, `--no-foo` is parsed as the flag `no-foo` and is not passed through to argv._.
findings.evidence: The diff removes `if (configuration['boolean-negation']) patterns.push(negatedBoolean);` and replaces it with an unconditional `hasFlagsMatching(arg, flagWithEquals, negatedBoolean, normalFlag)`. The main parse loop only treats an argument as a negation when `arg.match(negatedBoolean) && configuration['boolean-negation']` (line 253), so with negation off the parser never sees `--no-foo` as a negation of foo. isUnknownOption still reports it as known, so the argument skips the unknown-as-args path and is parsed as a separate key, e.g. `no-foo: true`. The two code paths now disagree on what counts as a known option.

findings.reason: The diff touches only lib/yargs-parser.ts. The only `'boolean-negation': false` test (test/yargs-parser.mjs:2533-2536) does not enable unknown-options-as-args, so the locked suite cannot catch the regression. I lowered severity from medium to low because this is a coverage gap, not a separate defect.
findings.claim: No test covers 'unknown-options-as-args': true together with 'boolean-negation': false, and the change adds no test.
findings.evidence: The diff changes only lib/yargs-parser.ts. In test/yargs-parser.mjs, the only `'boolean-negation': false` case (line 2536, 'does not negate arguments prefixed with --no-') does not enable unknown-options-as-args. None of the 'unknown-options-as-args = true' cases (lines 3047-3439) set boolean-negation to false or pass a `--no-<known>` argument.
